name: hopsesh
description: hopsesh: move coding-agent sessions between your machines and agents. Unofficial; not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI or Anomaly.

plugins.name: hopsesh
plugins.description: Move Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode sessions to another computer, continue one in another agent and back, or hand it to the cloud. The hopsesh skill lets your agent do it for you. Needs the hopsesh CLI.
